name: Crest
tagline: Album credits in Zune, fewer hitches while scrolling, and two crashes fixed.

highlights.title: Album credits in Zune
highlights.body: An album page now says who wrote, produced and played on the record, gathered from its songs' credits. Select "all credits" for everyone, grouped by role. A song's own credits sheet lists everyone again in Zune and WinUI.

highlights.title: Fewer hitches while you browse
highlights.body: Wavee reuses graphics memory instead of handing it back to the driver mid-frame, so the slowest frames while moving between pages take about half as long. Pages that slide in are drawn from one picture instead of being redrawn every frame. Large Zune titles are never cut at the left, and pages settle without jumping as they load.

highlights.title: Steadier
highlights.body: Restoring Wavee after a long time minimized no longer crashes it, and neither does a song starting at the moment the play log saves. Wavee now runs on .NET 11, which also fixes a security issue in the Brotli decoder, and crash reports explain sudden closes.
